opportunities.title: KWS SAAT - 'Partner with us' rolling partnership proposal intake (crop & field monitoring, data-driven insights, sustainable agriculture practices)
opportunities.program: KWS Innovation - Partner with us (Scouting & Licensing)
opportunities.deadline_text: No deadline stated; proposals submitted via a standing 'SUBMIT YOUR PROPOSAL' form.
opportunities.funding_text: Not specified. Page describes partnership forms (joint research, licensing, market access, financial investment, startup investments, joint ventures, spinouts); no grant amounts.
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Universities, research institutes, startups and industry partners (per page description).
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: No restriction stated; research institutes explicitly sought. CIAT/Alliance could submit a joint-research proposal (e.g., EO/AI crop and field monitoring, phenotyping) as lead partner. Terms (IP, funding) negotiated bilaterally.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Partner focus areas listed: plant trait discovery, breeding technologies, crop and field monitoring, sustainable agriculture practices, new markets and business models, data-driven insights.
opportunities.application_procedure: Submit proposal via kws.com/corp/en/innovation/partner-with-us/form/; contacts Dr. Stefan Schwarz (Lead Scouting & Licensing, stefan.schwarz@kws.com) and Daniel Guerrero (Manager Scouting & Licensing, daniel.guerrerobonilla@kws.com).
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Crop/field monitoring and data-driven insights match UAV/satellite phenotyping and ML skills, but KWS is a breeding company (maize, sugar beet, cereals, vegetables) with commercial IP focus, not coffee/cocoa or smallholder climate adaptation.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Commercial seed partner; limited fit with public-goods mandate; IP terms may conflict with CGIAR open-access policy.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Team has high-throughput phenotyping (RS + ML) capability that fits KWS scouting interests.
opportunities.recommendation: Low-priority, opportunistic: only pursue if a specific phenotyping/monitoring tool can be offered as a joint research project with funding to CIAT and acceptable IP terms. Not a grant programme; staff-cost coverage unknown.
opportunities.next_action: Optional: email Stefan Schwarz with a 1-page capability note on UAV/satellite phenotyping to ask whether KWS funds research-institute collaborations and on what IP terms.

evidence.deadline_quote: No deadline; page offers 'SUBMIT YOUR PROPOSAL' form.
evidence.eligibility_quote: KWS works with universities, research institutes, startups, and industry (page summary); seeking partners in 'crop and field monitoring' and 'data-driven insights'.
evidence.status_quote: In our fields of innovation, we are looking for strong partnerships to take technologies to the next level. Are you interested in partnering with us?

opportunities.verification_notes: Loaded official KWS partner-with-us page on 2026-11-04. It is a standing partnership/scouting intake, not a grant call; financial terms are negotiated case by case.

opportunities.title: Mosaic Company / Mosaic Company Foundation for Sustainable Food Systems - quarterly grant rounds (international orgs by invitation; India, China, Brazil focus) - next deadline 21 Dec 2026
opportunities.funder: The Mosaic Company and The Mosaic Company Foundation for Sustainable Food Systems
opportunities.program: Mosaic Funding Guidelines (Food: Global Agricultural Development, Agricultural Education; Water: Nutrient Stewardship)
opportunities.deadline_text: Application Deadline (due by midnight, EST): ... December 21, 2026 (review to April 19, 2027); next listed March 22 [2027] (review to July 19, 2027)
opportunities.funding_text: Not specified in guidelines. 'We prefer that requests not exceed 10 percent of your organization's annual operating budget and 50 percent of the program's annual budget.'
opportunities.eligible_applicants: 501(c)(3) (US) or CRA-registered charity (Canada), 'or hold an equivalent institutional registration'; must be in North America 'unless seeking a global or national partnership'. Internationally based organizations only on invitation.
opportunities.eligible_countries: Online system for US/Canada; international proposals for India, China or Brazil (Mosaic operating countries) by email first.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Alliance cannot use the online form directly; must email community.relations@mosaicco.com with a Food/Water opportunity in India (Alliance has a New Delhi office) or Brazil and be invited. A US-registered 501(c)(3) partner (e.g., CGIAR-affiliated US foundation) could alternatively apply for a 'global partnership'.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Registered charity or equivalent; nondiscrimination attestation.
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: North America, or India/China/Brazil by invitation.
opportunities.cofunding_details: Request preferably <=50% of program annual budget and <=10% of organization operating budget.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Global Agricultural Development (smallholder food security programs in developing nations); Agricultural Education (research, education, extension on soil health and balanced nutrition); Nutrient Stewardship in watersheds.
opportunities.application_procedure: Email community.relations@mosaicco.com describing an opportunity fitting Food/Water focus in India, China or Brazil; if invited, apply via online form by a quarterly deadline.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Fertilizer-company focus on soil health/balanced nutrition and smallholder extension; EO/AI only as supporting methods (e.g., nutrient-management decision tools).
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Only India/Brazil overlap; invitation-only for international orgs; modest grant sizes; fertilizer-industry funder.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Feasible if paired with Alliance India soil/nutrient team; outside researcher's core LAC work.
opportunities.recommendation: Low priority. Pursue only if Alliance India has a soil-health/nutrient-advisory project needing co-funding; send an inquiry email before the 21 Dec 2026 round.
opportunities.potential_partners: Alliance India office; S M Sehgal Foundation (past Mosaic grantee in India)
opportunities.next_action: Forward to Alliance Asia/India colleagues; if interested, email community.relations@mosaicco.com before mid-December 2026.

evidence.eligibility_quote: On rare occasion, we will invite internationally based organizations to apply through this form. If you have an opportunity ... in India, China, or Brazil ... please email us at community.relations@mosaicco.com.

opportunities.verification_notes: Read official 2026 Funding Guidelines PDF (revised Jan 2026) on 2026-11-04. Table lists a 'March 22, 2026' row after December 2026 that is evidently March 2027 (typo in source). Status set to monitoring because international applicants need an invitation.

monitor_sources.name: Common Grounds farmer programme / responsible sourcing
monitor_sources.why: Partnership approach: multi-year (3-10 yr) farmer projects co-designed with suppliers, NGOs and governments; also co-funds coffee cultivar research (via World Coffee Research, already tracked). No open call. Contact via jdepeets.com/contact-us (sustainability/green coffee sourcing team).

monitor_sources.name: AAA Sustainable Quality Program
monitor_sources.why: Partnership approach: programme co-designed with Rainforest Alliance; works through suppliers/agronomists and commissioned research (e.g., CRECE); 2030 regenerative sourcing target creates potential research/MRV partnerships. No open call; approach Nespresso sustainability/AAA team via Rainforest Alliance or supplier links.

monitor_sources.name: Fondazione Ernesto Illy - projects
monitor_sources.why: Invitation/partnership approach: funds scientific projects (Virtuous Agriculture, CIRAD coffee rust study, climate change and coffee, reforestation in Colombia, Ethiopian germplasm) and Ernesto Illy Colloquia with UNESCO-TWAS. No application process published. Contact info@fondazioneilly.org.

monitor_sources.name: Lavazza Foundation projects
monitor_sources.why: Partnership approach: 50+ projects in 20 countries implemented with local/NGO partners; founding member of Coffee&Climate (climate adaptation for smallholders). No call for proposals. Foundation site fondazionelavazza.com/en/; a UNDP page lists Davide Asinelli (Lavazza Foundation) as contact.

monitor_sources.name: Ferrero Farming Values / Hazelnut Company partnerships
monitor_sources.why: Partnership approach: FFV works with NGOs (Save the Children, Earthworm), universities and research institutes on cocoa, hazelnut, coffee; heavy EO/polygon traceability (Starling). No open call. Contact via Ferrero sustainability/FFV team.

monitor_sources.name: Cocoa For Good
monitor_sources.why: Partnership approach: 12-year USD 500M strategy in Cote d'Ivoire/Ghana; partners selected directly (CARE, Rainforest Alliance, PUR, ICI, Earthworm/Starling, Wageningen research). No proposal intake. Contact via Hershey sustainability team.

monitor_sources.name: Lindt Cocoa Foundation
monitor_sources.why: Partnership approach: funds projects 'with a focus on sustainable value chains, landscape projects, and research' in selected countries through partner organizations (e.g., Lindt Farming Program in Ghana, Madagascar, Ecuador; CHF 2-3M/yr). No application process. Contact via site Contact page (about-us/contact).

monitor_sources.name: Tony's Open Chain - mission allies
monitor_sources.why: Not a grant-maker: sourcing coalition of brands (mission allies) and processors applying 5 sourcing principles in Cote d'Ivoire/Ghana. Possible research/impact-evaluation contracting only. Contact via tonysopenchain.com.

monitor_sources.name: KDP corporate responsibility / coffee sourcing
monitor_sources.why: No public grant programme for coffee supply chains; engages farmers via supplier and NGO partners and funds World Coffee Research (already tracked). Watch annual impact report for new programmes.

monitor_sources.name: General Mills Foundation - Giving FAQs
monitor_sources.why: Invitation only ('invite-only basis'); grants focused on hunger/education near facilities. Regenerative agriculture funded by General Mills corporate via selected partners (Soil Health Academy, ALUS, NFWF), mostly North America. No open call.

monitor_sources.name: McCain Foundation
monitor_sources.why: Open application but restricted to registered Canadian charities in McCain operating communities; McCain Foods regen-ag work is via grower incentive programmes. Not usable by Alliance; monitor only for regen-ag research partnerships. Contact info@mccainfoundation.org.

monitor_sources.name: AGCO Agriculture Foundation
monitor_sources.why: Now invitation only ('accepts grant requests and proposals by invitation only'); previous open cycles 2022-2024 (2024: USD 400-450k over 3 years for nonprofits worldwide). Pillars: Youth in Agriculture, Agricultural Innovation, Community Empowerment. Contact agcofoundation@agcocorp.com to express interest.

monitor_sources.name: EWS-KT
monitor_sources.why: Implementer, not funder: delivers vegetable-farmer training (Asia/Africa) and seeks co-investment from donors; collaborates with research institutions (e.g., WUR). Potential implementation partner. Contact via kt.eastwestseed.com.

monitor_sources.name: BASF Innovate with us / Open Innovation Platform Agro
monitor_sources.why: Partnership approach: Open Innovation Platform (molecule screening), AgroStart (digital ag startups), temporary campaigns, bilateral academic alliances; precedent with CGIAR (IRRI OPTIMA Rice GHG collaboration). Watch for campaigns; approach via BASF Agricultural Solutions R&D/sustainability.

monitor_sources.name: KWS Partner with us
monitor_sources.why: Rolling partnership proposal form (see opportunities). Contacts Stefan Schwarz / Daniel Guerrero (Scouting & Licensing).

monitor_sources.name: Mosaic Funding Guidelines 2026
monitor_sources.why: Quarterly grant rounds; international orgs by invitation for India/China/Brazil via community.relations@mosaicco.com. Re-check guidelines each January.

monitor_sources.name: Bunge sustainable solutions / regenerative agriculture programmes
monitor_sources.why: No grant programme; regen-ag programmes (Brazil, Argentina, US, Canada, Poland w/ EIT Food, Romania, Hungary) pay farmer premiums and use tech partners (xFarm, Origeo). Possible MRV/EO partnership only by direct approach to Bunge sustainability team.

monitor_sources.name: ADM Cares
monitor_sources.why: Invitation only ('All grants are driven by ADM project champions and are by invitation only'); has funded international ag NGOs (TechnoServe India regen-ag, World Vision Vietnam). Express interest via the ADM Cares Contact Us form.

rejected_leads.title: General Mills Foundation regenerative agriculture grants
rejected_leads.reason: Invite-only; geographic focus within 50 miles of General Mills facilities; regen-ag partners mostly North America.

rejected_leads.title: McCain Foundation grants

rejected_leads.title: McCain Foods / FCC Sustainability Incentive Program and Future of Potato Farming Fund
rejected_leads.reason: Grower incentive programmes for Canadian potato farmers; not for research organizations (aggregator source only).

rejected_leads.title: AGCO Agriculture Foundation grant cycle 2025/2026

rejected_leads.title: East-West Seed Knowledge Transfer Foundation funding
rejected_leads.reason: Not a grant-maker; seeks co-investment itself.

rejected_leads.title: BASF Agricultural Solutions open research call
rejected_leads.reason: No dated open call; Open Innovation Platform is molecule screening, AgroStart targets startups.
